caption:
59.2 kilometres north along the Guanacaste surf coast to arrive at the bay in Tamarindo.

Day 6 of the ride leaves Nosara and runs past Ostional to San Juanillo, Marbella, and the reef breaks at Playa Negra and Avellanas. It is a fast 59.2 km with 782 m of climbing, strung along beaches rather than mountain ridges.

With the 100-kilometre traverse and the Nosara loop behind, the legs have done their hardest work. You roll into Tamarindo with the bay in front of you and park at Hotel Capitán Suizo for the final 2 nights.

We build the week so the biggest climbing sits in the middle, and the final stretch along the Pacific feels like a reward.

Day 6 of The Gravel Expedition. Next departures 23 to 31 January 2027 and 3 to 11 July 2027. Details in the bio.
